sourceOccurrences.label: Ancestral paths, depth events and the union bound
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected exposition with explicit additional deductions
sourceOccurrences.note: GGH2 groups the deterministic root-path and finite-level arguments with measurable depth events, the (kp)^n bound and subcritical extinction. The graph-containment formulation follows from the source raw-containment statement after loop erasure; arbitrary diagonal profiles remain allowed. Full connection events and finite ancestral-witness cylinders are distinguished.

sourceOccurrences.label: Subtree recursion and the endpoint-sensitive criterion
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected exposition with explicit additional deductions
sourceOccurrences.note: UHVH gives the exact recursion and positive-survival criterion, including k=1,p=1. The word-map, profile-pullback and scalar contracts are explained in the proof. Monotonicity retains s<=t<=1 without requiring s>=0. Susceptibility and critical-arm asymptotics reuse UKY4 and 8WO7 and are explicitly additional deductions. The original binary-specific assertions are preserved.

sourceOccurrences.label: Rooted-tree two-point, susceptibility and binary survival laws
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected exposition with explicit scope distinctions
sourceOccurrences.note: CQYY is the binary specialization. The source also gives root connection and susceptibility formulas for every finite branching number, including zero, with arbitrary diagonal marginals. The appendix supplies the direct depth sum and positive-fixed-point argument. The extended inverse uses truncated subtraction; no negative susceptibility is inferred above criticality.

sourceOccurrences.label: Tree geometry and the critical binary arm
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected exposition with explicit scope distinctions
sourceOccurrences.note: NDIC matches the binary case; the two-point source permits every finite branching number and all vertex pairs. The reciprocal argument proves the scalar critical limit without importing general branching asymptotics. The probability arm exports use the canonical half-open tree profile and ancestral cylinders; arbitrary diagonal marginals follow by the graph-event comparison.

sourceOccurrences.label: Binary cluster shapes and the Catalan law
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected exposition with explicit scope distinctions
sourceOccurrences.note: 9K6O is the exact unconditioned finite-size law for n >= 1, including p=0 and p=1. The inventory preserves explicit finite-cluster events, the raw tree-support hypothesis of the deterministic pattern lemma, and arbitrary diagonal profiles in the probability statements. The binary-tree bijection is explained; Stirling, cutoff and moment asymptotics are additional exposition, not exports.

proofUses.reason: The almost-sure tree support and unique ancestral paths identify depth cylinders; finite levels and the union bound give decay.
Subtree pullback and independent coordinate blocks give the depth recursion; diagonal erasure extends the canonical profile calculation.
The root cluster is a Bin(2,p) Galton-Watson process; the proof applies the extinction criterion (BFM4), the least-fixed-point characterisation (8TFY) and the expected total progeny (UKY4).
